slug: 2021-06-29 Mozambique Digital Governance and Economy Project - PID (EDGE, P172350, World Bank)

facts.fact: The World Bank's appraisal-stage project document of 29 June 2021 proposes US$58 million of a US$150 million IDA grant for civil registration and identification, supporting the Ministries of Justice and Interior, including digitisation of paper registration records into e-SIRCEV, mobile civil registration logistics and a unique identification number; a further US$13 million subcomponent buys broadband connectivity for agencies such as civil registration and identification.
